test.title: The wall that keeps a house cool

paragraphs.text: In hot, dry regions builders have long used thick walls of earth. The wall absorbs heat all day and releases it at night, so the rooms stay cool while the sun is up.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The trick fails in humid places. There the night is almost as warm as the day, and the wall has no cool hours in which to give its heat back.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Modern versions exist. One company makes panels filled with a wax that melts at 24 degrees, absorbing heat as it melts and hardening again overnight.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Such panels are light enough for an ordinary ceiling, but they cost several times more than plasterboard, and builders unfamiliar with them often fit them the wrong way round.
paragraphs.label: D

explanation.en: Wax panels repeat the same principle — paragraph C.

items.quote: There the night is almost as warm as the day
items.prompt: a condition in which the old method does not help

explanation.en: In humid places the night is warm, so it fails — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Ылғалды климатта түн жылы — әдіс жұмыс істемейді, B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Во влажном климате ночь тёплая — метод не работает, абзац B.

items.quote: they cost several times more than plasterboard, and builders unfamiliar with them often fit them the wrong way round

explanation.en: Cost and fitting mistakes are in paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Баға мен орнату қателері — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Цена и ошибки монтажа — абзац D.

items.quote: The wall absorbs heat all day and releases it at night
items.prompt: how a thick earth wall behaves over a day

explanation.en: The wall stores heat by day and releases it at night — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Қабырға күндіз жылу жинап, түнде береді — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Стена копит тепло днём и отдаёт ночью — абзац A.
